These slides were built with coding agents, working from a brief and a run
of corrections.
This page is what I asked for and what I said back, with the typos
corrected.
The [AIandIDVUB prompts page](https://samabbott.co.uk/AIandIDVUB/prompts.html)
does the same for an earlier talk.

## How these slides were built

One Claude Code session, running Claude Opus, built the deck on 2 November 2026 between about 12:50 and 17:00 UTC.
I sent it about 46 messages.
It replied in 643 turns and made 326 tool calls.
Most were shell commands (222), to render the deck, take screenshots, query GitHub and commit.
The rest were file reads (84), web fetches (5), file writes (4), messages to a subagent (5), subagent launches (4), one skill and one tool search.

Four subagents did side jobs, with 197 tool calls between them.

| Subagent | Tool calls |
|---|---|
| Find figures from other groups, including 19 web searches | 72 |
| Review the first draft | 32 |
| Review the second draft | 37 |
| Draw the agent, multi-agent and time schematics | 56 |

The repository has 30 commits from the session, all by seabbs-bot with me as co-author.
These counts come from the session logs and are a snapshot from late in the build.
